brief.t: START HERE: Put Roon Body's immediate 1,500-unit run into the next available floor slot and send Josh firm start and completion dates now.

Send: Josh, I am locking the immediate 1,500 unit run into the next available floor slot now and will send you firm start and completion dates today.

ACT NOW 2: Polo container EMCU8614105 remains on a stale customs-exam status, and Price Transfer has waited 3 calendar days for Aidan's broker contact. Price Transfer and Polo are waiting. Send: Roxi, the broker contact is [NAME, EMAIL, PHONE]. Please confirm the current exam status, release status, charges, and earliest pickup time today.

ACT NOW 3: TALOVA's request for 500 additional lip balms and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 units remains unanswered 10 calendar days later. Marcello is waiting. Send: Marcello, I am confirming stock or build timing for the additional 500 and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 now. I will give you both answers today.
